answers.core: Depending on the implementation, may require being core for runtime performance. Could possibly be implemented as gdnative in 4.x but most seem keen on this being available in core.
answers.workaround: Although mesh merging can be done entirely from gdscript, or using the existing `MeshInstance::merge_meshes()` function in 3.x, we want to make it as easy to use as possible (and port to 4.x).
